items.title: Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Booster: how to use it #shorts
items.hook: The Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Booster: what's in it and how to use it.
facts: Formulated with salicylic acid to help combat breakout-causing bacteria
TT Technology and phytoplankton extract help prevent over-drying
Niacinamide reinforces the skin's barrier and helps even skin tone
Apply to a blemish, or a thin layer under moisturiser for breakout prevention

scenes.caption: Breakout Clearing Booster
scenes.say: Meet the Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Booster. It clears breakouts fast, and you can use it daily, morning and night, as needed.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid
scenes.say: This fast-acting booster is formulated with salicylic acid to help combat breakout-causing bacteria for rapid skin clearing.

scenes.caption: TT Technology + phytoplankton
scenes.say: Patented TT Technology and phytoplankton extract work with skin's natural microbiome and help prevent over-drying.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide
scenes.say: Niacinamide reinforces the skin's defensive barrier and helps to even skin tone.

scenes.caption: Spot or thin layer
scenes.say: Apply it directly to a blemish or breakout area, or a thin layer all over the face under your moisturiser for breakout prevention.

scenes.caption: New to it? Test first
scenes.say: First time? Apply it to a small area once a day for three days, and avoid broken or irritated skin. The link is in the description.

scenes.caption: Blackhead Clearing Fizz Mask
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Blackhead Clearing Fizz Mask. It clears pores and blackheads.

scenes.caption: Active fizzing formula
scenes.say: Its active fizzing formula activates on application, helping to open pores, decongest skin and clear blackheads.

scenes.caption: Sulfur + kaolin clay
scenes.say: Sulfur helps keep skin clear, and kaolin clay absorbs excess oil and purifies the skin.

scenes.caption: Leave 3 to 5 minutes
scenes.say: Apply it to areas of congestion and allow three to five minutes to fully activate. Then rinse thoroughly.

scenes.caption: Patch test first
scenes.say: Known sensitivity to an ingredient? Patch test first, and avoid it if you're allergic to sulfur. The link is in the description.

scenes.caption: Post-Breakout Fix
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Post-Breakout Fix, a gel-cream spot treatment for post-breakout marks.

scenes.caption: Red and dark spots
scenes.say: It helps fade and brighten the red and dark spots that breakouts leave behind, both new and old.

scenes.caption: Hexylresorcinol + salicylic acid
scenes.say: Hexylresorcinol helps fade post-breakout marks and brighten skin's appearance, and salicylic acid gently exfoliates and helps even skin tone.

scenes.caption: Carob seed + squalane
scenes.say: Carob seed extract supports visibly calmer, clearer looking skin, and squalane helps moisturise and stabilise the skin's barrier.

scenes.caption: Twice a day
scenes.say: After cleansing and toning, apply a small amount directly to the spot, twice a day or as needed, until the mark fades. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Breakout Biotic Moisturiser: ingredients, skin types and how to use it
items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica Breakout Biotic Moisturiser: what's in it, who it's for and how to use it.
facts: Daily breakout-targeting gel moisturiser with a prebiotic blend
Salicylic acid (0.5%) exfoliates dead skin cells to help keep pores clear
Niacinamide and jojoba strengthen the barrier and reduce the look of pores and marks
Manuka and magnolia extracts visibly reduce sebum
After cleansing and toning, apply in light upward strokes; follow with SPF by day

scenes.caption: Breakout Biotic Moisturiser
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Breakout Biotic Moisturiser. In the next few minutes, we'll go through what's in it, who it's for, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: A daily gel moisturiser
scenes.say: It's a daily, breakout-targeting gel that helps prevent breakouts. It's a lightweight moisturiser with a prebiotic blend that hydrates and supports the skin's microbiome.

scenes.caption: Treats + prevents breakouts
scenes.say: It's made to treat and prevent breakouts every day, hydrate and support the skin's microbiome, and help ageing skin look healthier, now and in the future.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid 0.5%
scenes.say: The active ingredient is salicylic acid, at zero point five percent. Salicylic acid reduces acne by exfoliating away dead skin cells, helping to keep pores clear and prevent future breakouts.

scenes.caption: Plankton extract + glycerin
scenes.say: Bioengineered plankton extract and glycerin hydrate the skin's barrier, helping to defend against signs of premature ageing, and soothe the skin.

scenes.caption: The prebiotic blend
scenes.say: The prebiotic blend, with Indian mulberry, glutamic acid and agave-derived inulin, hydrates and helps balance the skin's microbiome.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide + jojoba
scenes.say: Niacinamide and jojoba strengthen the skin barrier, helping to reduce the look of pores and post-blemish marks, to brighten and smooth.

scenes.caption: Manuka + magnolia
scenes.say: And manuka and magnolia extracts visibly reduce sebum, for more balanced skin.

scenes.caption: Who it's for
scenes.say: It's best for acne-prone, oily or combination skin, and for skin that needs lightweight hydration with sebum control and pore refinement.

scenes.caption: Lightweight gel texture
scenes.say: The texture is a lightweight gel. It hydrates without heavy residue, and it layers well under other products.

scenes.caption: Cleanse, tone, then apply
scenes.say: To use it, cleanse and tone first. Then apply it over your face and neck in light, upward strokes.

scenes.caption: SPF in the morning
scenes.say: In the morning, follow with sunscreen.

scenes.caption: Using other actives?
scenes.say: You can layer it with other treatments. If you're combining it with strong actives, like retinoids or exfoliants, introduce them gradually and patch test to watch for irritation.

scenes.caption: Breakout Biotic Moisturiser
scenes.say: That's the Dermalogica Breakout Biotic Moisturiser. You'll find the link in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash: full guide to ingredients and routine
items.hook: A full look at the Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash: what's in it, who it's for and how to use it.
facts: Active ingredient: salicylic acid 0.5%
8 botanicals including tea tree, lavender and camellia sinensis, plus orange peel extract
Use morning and night on the face, neck, chest and back
Pea-sized amount lathered in wet hands; avoid the eyes; rinse with warm water

scenes.caption: Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash
scenes.say: This is the Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash. In the next few minutes, we'll cover what's in it, who it's for, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Deep cleans + purifies
scenes.say: It deep cleans and purifies skin. This breakout-fighting foaming wash clears away dead skin cells, dirt and excess oils that clog pores and cause breakouts.

scenes.caption: Morning and night
scenes.say: You use it daily, morning and night, on your face, back, neck, or wherever skin needs deep cleaning and pore clearing for fewer breakouts.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid 0.5%
scenes.say: The active ingredient is salicylic acid, at zero point five percent. Salicylic acid dives deep into pores, clearing dead skin cells and trapped oils to help wipe out existing and future breakouts.

scenes.caption: 8 botanicals
scenes.say: It's formulated with eight botanicals, including tea tree, lavender and camellia sinensis, known to gently soothe and calm irritated skin.

scenes.caption: Orange peel extract
scenes.say: And orange peel extract revives, energises and refreshes.

scenes.caption: All skin types
scenes.say: It's recommended for all skin types, including combination to oily, and it targets breakouts, clogged pores and dull skin.

scenes.caption: Gentle, non-stripping
scenes.say: It's described as a gentle, non-stripping foaming wash, designed to cleanse without over-drying.

scenes.caption: Step 1: lather
scenes.say: Here's how to use it. Work a pea-sized amount into a lather in wet hands.

scenes.caption: Step 2: massage
scenes.say: Apply it to your dampened face, neck, back and chest, massaging in circular motions, and concentrate on areas of congestion and oiliness.

scenes.caption: Step 3: rinse
scenes.say: Avoid the eye area, and rinse thoroughly with warm water.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin?
scenes.say: If you have sensitive skin, you can use it, but you may want to patch test first if you have a known sensitivity to a specific ingredient.

scenes.caption: Vegan + cruelty free
scenes.say: It's certified vegan and cruelty free, with no artificial colours or fragrances, and it comes in a 177 millilitre and a 295 millilitre size.

scenes.caption: Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash
scenes.say: That's the Dermalogica Breakout Clearing Foaming Wash. You'll find the link in the description.
